about: A merkleblock of block 540107 that matches its last transaction, at index 229 of its 230, counting the coinbase as 0: 6 hashes and 2 flag octets. Three levels of a tree of 230 have an odd width, 115, 29 and 15 nodes at heights 1, 3 and 4, and the walk to index 229 passes through the last node of each, so the nodes above them, at heights 2, 4 and 5, have no right child and pair that node's hash with itself. A parser that walks it as Bitcoin Core's CPartialMerkleTree does finds it well formed, with total_txs 230, matching that transaction and reaching the header's Merkle root field.
source: Mainnet block 540107, whole, in btcd's test file testdata/block-00000000000000000021868c2cefc52a480d173c849412fe81c4e5ab806f94ab.blk (github.com/btcsuite/btcd/wire/v2 v2.0.1); mempool.space's Esplora API gave the same hash for height 540107 on 2026-09-27. Each merkleblock is built from the block's 230 transactions, as Bitcoin Core's CPartialMerkleTree builds one.
